racketvision.name: RacketVision BallTrack + RacketPose
racketvision.input: Original consecutive BGR video frames; median background; racket detector boxes
racketvision.output: Native-frame shuttle XY and five racket keypoints with scores
racketvision.hardware: CPU, CUDA, Apple Silicon MPS (local NMS/InstanceData compatibility); legacy dependencies isolated
limitations: Counts and heatmap scores are not accuracy
Clip-specific sampled median differs from author match-wide preprocessing
Released inference.py's input is one frame early; this adapter follows author training dataset alignment
Racket keypoints are 2D, not a validated 3D face normal

shuttlehitformer.name: ShuttleHitFormer
shuttlehitformer.reason: 本地修正版已完成训练和公开坐标特征测试：职业找拍F1为91.5%，业余55.8%（±3帧）。已修复信息丢失、训练不足和权重选择；不使用缺失的球网点。原始录像自动提取特征后的端到端效果仍未验证，当前默认报告不使用实验权重。
shuttlehitformer.output: frame-level hit probability; player attribution not independently validated by the reported event metric
limitations: Explicit local residual and court-only variant; not the unpublished author implementation
Published feature data evaluation does not measure raw-video frontend quality
Amateur transfer recall45.9%; substantial missed contacts remain
Collections previously inspected in project development; fresh independent videos still needed

evaluation.input: published pose/shuttle/court coordinate features, including manual/human-associated measurements
evaluation.scope: development evaluation; not end-to-end raw video or an untouched final benchmark

dsta.name: DSTA + VideoMAE + ActionFormer
dsta.reason: Paper-derived local architecture, training and inference implemented; local pilot weights are experimental. No validated official or locally benchmarked full-training checkpoint.
dsta.input: Independent RGB video feature pathway, resampled 25 fps, 160x160; temporal, vertical and horizontal adapters
dsta.output: stroke intervals with fine-grained class scores
dsta.label_mapping: label_map.json; retain unknown official labels; no invented numeric class order

explainable_assessment.name: ERA 2026 six SPIs + hierarchical Mamdani fuzzy inference
explainable_assessment.reason: COCO17 lacks hand points; monocular video lacks validated wrist metric scale and racket 3D normals; stroke-specific validated reference parameters are required. Raw 2D observations are separate from quality scores.

monocular_pose3d.name: Optional MediaPipe monocular3D pose
monocular_pose3d.reason: Hip-origin3D estimates with uncalibrated depth and scale;2D baseline retained. No action classifier is added.
